text:
Home Bargains is selling the bathroom organiser(Image: Getty)

Shoppers looking for 'luxurious' homeware could be in luck at Home Bargains. Popular for selling furniture and accessories, the store sells products for most rooms in the house, including the bathroom.

One 'fabulous' £6.99 item could impress customers keen to spruce up their bathroom. Home Bargains is selling a Bathroom Over Bath Rack that helps shoppers enjoy a relaxing bath. According to the high street giant, the design "lets you enjoy your favourite book, podcast, or show in style and comfort."

As shown in the product images, the shelf can hold items like soap and keep the bath side clear. Home Bargains told shoppers: "Transform your bath time into a luxurious retreat with our Bathroom Over Bath Rack!

"Designed to keep your essentials within reach, its slatted design lets you enjoy your favourite book, podcast, or show in style and comfort. There is nothing better than a nice relaxing bath, with your favourite book, podcast or tv show.

"However, leaning over the bath to enjoy them makes the experience feel a little less luxurious. This over bath rack is the perfect way to enjoy your favourite bath time indulgences, and feel fabulous doing it!"

Bathroom Over Bath Rack(Image: Home Bargains)

Available online now, the rack is sold in several colours, allowing shoppers to match their shelf to their design theme. However, the colours are subject to availability.

At the time of writing, the shelf is available in black, grey, or white, but the natural wood colour is currently out of stock. Customers interested in the colour can sign up for stock notifications.

Elsewhere, Dunelm also sells a £26 Acacia Wood Bath Rack that could impress customers looking for another look. The product description says: "Keep all your items to hand for a relaxing bathing experience with this bath rack.

The bath rack is available in several colours(Image: Home Bargains)

"Stylishly designed and made from natural acacia wood, this is a great addition to Scandi or minimalist-designed bathrooms. Matching items are available to complete the look."

The product is popular with reviewers. Rating their purchase, one customer said: "Omg love so much looks so expensive!! The cup holder and iPad holder are amazing." Another shopper wrote: "Lovely colour. Perfect uncluttered design. Easily stored when not in use."

More praise read: "I really like the look of this in my bathroom. Exactly as pictured and fits nicely." Someone else replied: "Looks great, glad I paid a bit extra compared to other bath racks I looked at. Love the colour too!!!!"
